Frequently asked questions

What is the Xfinity 5-Year Price Guarantee?
The Xfinity 5-Year Price Guarantee locks in your base monthly home internet rate for 60 months. You get one simple, consistent price with no annual contract required and the option to change or cancel your service at any time. Current plans also get you WiFi equipment and unlimited data included in that price. Plus if you move to a new address in our service area, your rate still stays the same.
Is there a contract or early termination fee?
No, there is no annual contract or early termination fee. You can cancel any time without a penalty.
What is WiFi Shield and how does it help protect your home network?

WiFi Shield is suite of features built into your Xfinity Gateway designed to keep you informed and at ease, day and night. It’s included with your Xfinity Internet service — no additional cost or equipment. WiFi Shield includes:

 

  • • WiFi Motion: Away or asleep, detect movement in your home with your smart devices. No cameras needed.
  • • Xfinity CyberSecure: Always-on protection on all your devices from the moment you connect.
  • • Dark Watch: Rest easy with Dark Watch. Customize your notifications for while you sleep.
  • • Home Watch & Away Watch: Home or away customize notifications based on what’s happening in your life.
  • • Family Settings: Help your family explore online safely. Pause WiFi, block unwanted sites, and monitor use.

 

Restrictions apply. Not avail. in all areas. Compatible gateway req. for select WiFi Shield features.

Has Xfinity won any awards for internet service?

Yes. Opensignal— an independent research company that uses real-world data from millions of users — named Xfinity “the fastest & most reliable WiFi” in its Fixed Broadband Experience Report (May 2026) and "America's best quality combined WiFi + Mobile" in its Converged Experience Report (April 2026). Xfinity beat Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile in both reports.

 

Plus that’s not all. U.S. News & World Report also named Xfinity Best Internet Service Provider Overall, and Newsweek ranked Xfinity a #1 Most Trusted Brand in America (2026). See all the awards Xfinity won in 2026.

Are there hidden fees or extra charges?
Our pricing is transparent so there will be no surprises on your bill. When you lock in our offers, it locks in your base monthly rate. Our latest internet plans include WiFi equipment and unlimited data in the cost, so you won't have surprise rental fees or data overages.
How do I confirm I have the 5-Year Price Guarantee?
You’ll find the 5-Year Price Guarantee discount reflected in your cart before completing your order, in your order confirmation, and on your bill.
Can I change my plan?
You can upgrade or switch your internet plan at any time without penalties or fees, however pricing may change depending on offers available at the time.

So, if your home internet is slow or unreliable, you can experience slow video calls, laggy streaming, and dropped connections. When you get home internet and mobile service from the same provider, your device should instantly transition between home internet and cell towers.
